heading.en: Cover a row and a column

hook.en: Put your finger on one entry of a 3 × 3 determinant and cover its row and column. The small determinant left over is its minor, and with the right sign it becomes the cofactor.
hook.kn: 3 × 3 ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕದ ಒಂದು ಅಂಶದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆರಳಿಟ್ಟು ಅದರ ಸಾಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕಂಬಸಾಲು ಮುಚ್ಚಿ. ಉಳಿದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕವೇ ಉಪನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ; ಸರಿಯಾದ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಸಹಗುಣಕ.

say.en: Put your finger on one entry of a 3 times 3 determinant and cover its row and column. The small determinant left over is its minor, and with the right sign it becomes the cofactor. In this lesson: Find minors and cofactors.
Expand a determinant with cofactors.
Know that "alien" cofactors give zero.

body.en: The *minor* $M_{ij}$ of $a_{ij}$ is the determinant left after deleting row $i$ and column $j$. The cofactor is $A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j} M_{ij}$. Then $|A| = a_{11}A_{11} + a_{12}A_{12} + a_{13}A_{13}$ (any row or column). Elements of one row times cofactors of a different row add up to 0.
body.kn: aᵢⱼ ನ ಸಾಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕಂಬಸಾಲು ಅಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಉಳಿಯುವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ ಉಪನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ Mᵢⱼ. ಸಹಗುಣಕ Aᵢⱼ = (−1)ⁱ⁺ʲ Mᵢⱼ. ಒಂದು ಸಾಲಿನ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಸಾಲಿನ ಸಹಗುಣಕಗಳಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸೊನ್ನೆ.

narration.en: The minor is the determinant left after deleting the row and column of an element. The cofactor is the minor with sign minus one to the power i plus j. Elements of a row times their own cofactors give the determinant; times another row's cofactors they give zero.
narration.kn: aᵢⱼ ನ ಸಾಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕಂಬಸಾಲು ಅಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಉಳಿಯುವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ ಉಪನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ Mᵢⱼ. ಸಹಗುಣಕ Aᵢⱼ = (−1)ⁱ⁺ʲ Mᵢⱼ. ಒಂದು ಸಾಲಿನ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಸಾಲಿನ ಸಹಗುಣಕಗಳಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸೊನ್ನೆ.

say.en: |A| = Σ a ijA ij along one row.
a 11A 21 plus a 12A 22 plus a 13A 23 equals 0.

title.en: Hide a row and a column

say.en: To get the minor of a one two, hide row 1 and column 2. The determinant of what is left is the minor.
The cofactor attaches a sign: minus one to the power i plus j. Position 1 2 has a minus sign.
Multiply each element of a row by its own cofactor and add: that is the determinant. Here it is minus 3.
With the cofactors of a different row, the sum is always zero.

narration.en: Change a, b and c. The determinant is a times its cofactor, plus 2 times its cofactor, plus 3 times its cofactor.

problem.en: Find all minors and cofactors of |1 −2; 4 3|.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find all minors and cofactors of |1 −2; 4 3|.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find all minors and cofactors of |1 minus 2; 4 3|.
M 11 equals 3, M 12 equals 4, M 21 equals minus 2, M 22 equals 1.
Apply signs plus - / - plus.
A 11 equals 3, A 12 equals minus 4, A 21 equals 2, A 22 equals 1.
So the answer is A 11 equals 3, A 12 equals minus 4, A 21 equals 2, A 22 equals 1.

problem.en: For Δ = |1 2 3; 0 1 4; 5 6 0|, find the cofactor A₂₁.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For Δ = |1 2 3; 0 1 4; 5 6 0|, find the cofactor A₂₁.

say.en: Let us solve this together. For delta = |1 2 3; 0 1 4; 5 6 0|, find the cofactor A 21.
Delete row 2 and column 1: M 21 = |2 3; 6 0| = 0 minus 18 equals minus 18.
A 21 equals minus 1 cubed times minus 18 equals 18.
So the answer is 18.
